text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping at the 
commercial district with Royce and Royce—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We got a lottery ticket. Since we're here, 
let's draw before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Fun and delicious lottery here! Lottery, 
step right up! How about a sweet, sweet 
lottery prize?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...The man running the raffle looks 
utterly exhausted. His hawking call has 
completely turned into a roasted sweet 
potato pitch..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hot-off-the-press lottery tickets here~. 
Lottery, lottery. Who wants some delicious 
lottery tickets~?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If we just keep following the manual by 
the book, our hearts will wither away 
too...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Time for me to give an exaggerated 
reaction and bring a little joy to that 
old man's heart!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's good practice for character building 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Full of enthusiasm, Royce and Royce 
cranked the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hot springs?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaa~~~h! A hot springs trip!! The 
grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's the grand prize, the grand 
prize!! I won the absolute best one~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, seeing you this happy makes me happy 
too! Here ya go, your prize!
choice_data_list:
You really brought back the old man's 
vitality!

You really brought back the old man's 
vitality!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh? —Wait, that's right! I just got 
completely carried away celebrating!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The prize is a hot springs trip voucher... 
Unfortunately, we can't go right now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's use it once things settle down. Yes, 
maybe around next spring?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you should take a nice, relaxing 
break at the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're coming too, you know! These 
raffle tickets came from buying equipment 
for both of us, after all.
choice_data_list: Huh? It's fine, you use it!
Huh? It's fine, you can use it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. We're just going to argue in circles 
at this rate... I know!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's just call it a school trip!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Look, Trainer, you said so before, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
They say when you grow up, you remember 
the sparkle of your youth. That time looks 
so dazzling and bright—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Are you so nostalgic for your youth that 
you want to relive it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Then let's experience youth together!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"When you think of trips during your 
youth, it's gotta be school trips, right?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, producing a school trip! I'm 
itching to get started! Look forward to 
it, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The prize hot springs trip somehow turned 
into a school excursion... Even so, I 
found myself feeling a little excited 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Carrot... Salisbury steak...! Ugh, 
uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it just reminded me... Of the 
carrot hamburger steak Mom used to make.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The day I went back home... Mom casually 
asked me what I wanted for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I... had my hands full, so without 
thinking, I just told you that anything 
was fine...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My mother made me the carrot Salisbury 
steak with sweet sauce that I loved so 
much as a child...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like I'm a little kid 
anymore, you know. Though remembering that 
taste...—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Little lady...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I really, really want to eat 
Mom's carrot hamburg steak!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna eat it with Mom's sauce! Is it 
okay if I call her real quick?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mom taught me the recipe for the sauce, 
too! Thanks to that, I won't have to crave 
home cooking before my next trip home!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to this carrot hamburger 
steak. I'll enjoy every bite♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! My, little lady, you sure are 
expressive!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
One moment she's crying, the next she's 
passionately explaining something! I never 
get tired of watching her!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. If I was able to move an 
older gentleman's heart, I'm honored!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The old man seemed intrigued by Royce and 
Royce's mysteriously dramatic showmanship!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A mountain of carrots... Lots of 
carrots... OK, got it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Liiike I saaaid!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Super many-many extra carrots, Heap 'em 
on, plea~se♡ 'Cause I'm gonna gobble up 
many-many more~♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Super many-many, pack 'em super tight, 
Carrots plea~se♡ 'Cause I'm definitely, 
DEFINITELY gonna eat double~♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Is giving it in person too heavy, I 
wonder? Isn't it way too intense?! But 
wait, wouldn't it be fine??"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Gimme!! T-H-A-N-K Y-O-U for the 2nd prize 
carrots~~âª

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: ! T-Thump?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that was quite the reaction befitting 
an Umamusume, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too much brute force?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But look, you got the old man's 
energy back, so—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak! 2nd prize is a whole bunch of 
carrots, pretty please~♪ 3rd prize is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, for a while after that, the 
lottery stall's background music became 
"Menishuki♡Rush-shu!"...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A carrot, just one...? *glance*

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's any freebie with 
this...? *glance* *glance*

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if you look at me like that, I can 
only give you one carrot!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Can I... redraw? *glance, glance*

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
No, no! If you wanna draw again, go do 
some shopping and get a raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. Sorry for being so demanding. I 
was just really looking forward to the 
lottery draw.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: No... c-come visit again!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting 
lottery draw!
choice_data_list:
I got turned away, but... was that 
expected?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Look at your uncle. You've cheered up 
now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The reason for the drop in motivation was 
that things had become monotonous. I just 
gave them a little incident to break the 
routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the spark Royce and Royce 
provided, the raffle stall came right back 
to life!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...... Tissues, huhhh...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, tough luck! Do some more shopping 
and come draw again!
choice_data_list:
Looks like it was quite the inspiration 
for the old man!

Looks like it was quite the inspiration 
for the old man!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Now that you mention it, that's 
true. I was so disappointed that I 
completely forgot.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was a bust, and if anything, my spirits 
are the ones that have withered...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her spirit utterly drained of vitality, 
Royce and Royce trudged dejectedly back 
home...
